scientific_integrity: The arclength statement is deduced analytically from a finite combinatorial formula, exponential tilting, the classical local limit theorem, and an evaluated beta integral. The accompanying finite numerical checks do not independently certify the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Requires a fixed, fully supported, nonuniform iid digit law; does not address boundary distributions, varying dice, uniform-in-bias error estimates, or explicit next-order error bounds. Uses standard nonlattice and lattice local limit theorems. Unindexed earlier work remains a novelty risk.
title: Sharp Chernoff-scale arclength convergence for unfair-die distribution functions
